race.name: Lexus Melbourne Cup (G1)
race.track_condition_morning: Soft 5 (expected to improve; heavy rain forecast possible)
notes: Defiantly scratched on Derby morning (failed vet check); Kizlyar gained a start.
Harry Coffey (Shockletz) suffered a collarbone injury in a Derby Day fall - check rider confirmation before betting on Shockletz.
Since 2015 every Cup winner has jumped from barrier 19 or inside.

horses.name: Sons And Lovers
horses.lead_up: Won G2 3000m in Riyadh (Feb) and G2 Prix Maurice de Nieuil 2800m (Jul); 2nd G3 Kilternan Stakes 2414m (Sep). Topweight, first-up in Australia after 52-day break.

horses.name: Trustyourinstinct
horses.lead_up: Won G2 Curragh Cup 2816m (Jul); 4th G1 Irish St Leger 2816m behind Scandinavia (Sep). Prefers a good track; wide gate.

horses.name: Knight's Choice
horses.lead_up: 2024 Melbourne Cup winner. 3rd G2 Herbert Power 2400m, then 14th Caulfield Cup (eased early).

horses.name: Middle Earth
horses.lead_up: 3rd in the 2025 Cup. 9th Caulfield Cup (5.5L), 8th Cox Plate 2040m. Rails draw; two-time Cup-winning jockey.

horses.name: Vauban
horses.lead_up: Fourth Cup (14th, 11th, 6th). 9th Geelong Cup first-up. Nine-year-old from a wide gate.

horses.name: Enfjaar
horses.lead_up: 3rd Caulfield Cup (1L) first-up; won Glorious Stakes at Goodwood. Never raced beyond 2414m.

horses.name: Royal Supremacy
horses.lead_up: Won G3 JRA Cup 2000m, then 15th Caulfield Cup (17L). Leader drawn wide.

horses.name: Wine Dark Sea
horses.lead_up: Won Geoffrey Freer at Newbury; 11th Caulfield Cup after racing wide without cover. Rain would help.

horses.name: Asterix
horses.lead_up: Last in Turnbull Stakes, 12th Caulfield Cup. 4th Auckland Cup 3200m previously.

horses.name: Goodie Two Shoes
horses.lead_up: 2nd in the 2025 Cup at $41 (51.5kg). Won G2 Lillie Langtry 2816m; last in Kilternan Stakes. 3.5kg more this year; wants a firm track.

horses.name: Juja Kibo
horses.lead_up: Won The Metropolitan 2400m (soft) and G2 Moonee Valley Cup 2500m. Only 3200m run was 9th in the Sydney Cup.

horses.name: Hopewell Rock
horses.lead_up: Won 2816m handicap at Goodwood with 61kg (beat Small Fry, later 2nd in Geelong Cup); 2nd by a head in the Ebor 2816m on soft ground. Handles rain; first-up from a spell.

horses.name: Onesmoothoperator
horses.lead_up: Third Cup (12th, 16th before). 9th Herbert Power, 11th Geelong Cup.

horses.name: Soul Of Spain
horses.lead_up: 2nd Sydney Cup 3200m. 7th Metropolitan, 8th Caulfield Cup after a mid-race move. Good gate.

horses.name: Zahrann
horses.lead_up: Won G2 Naturalism Stakes (beat Saint George); 6th Caulfield Cup when held up. Never beyond 2400m; dislikes heavy ground.

horses.name: So You Are
horses.lead_up: Four straight wins: Tatts Cup, Colin Stephen Quality 2400m, ATC St Leger 2600m (soft), Bendigo Cup 2400m. Big class rise.

horses.name: Future History
horses.lead_up: 4th Herbert Power, 9th Moonee Valley Cup. 15th in the 2023 Cup. Ridden by the 2025 winning jockey.

horses.name: James J Braddock
horses.lead_up: 3rd Epsom Derby; 6th Kilternan Stakes first-up after gelding. Three-year-old trying two miles; widest gate; better on wet ground.

horses.name: Kizlyar
horses.lead_up: Won Ascot Stakes 4013m at Royal Ascot (beat Defiantly); 11th as favourite in the Moonee Valley Cup.

horses.name: Point Of Law
horses.lead_up: Won Bahrain Trophy 2615m and G3 Geelong Cup 2400m on Australian debut; 4th Queen's Vase 2816m. Only his sixth start; best on dry ground.

horses.name: Strictly Business
horses.lead_up: 2025 VRC Oaks winner; at or near the tail in her last three starts.

horses.name: Mr Monaco
horses.lead_up: Won Bart Cummings 2500m at Flemington; 3rd Moonee Valley Cup. 11th Sydney Cup at 3200m. More rain the better.

horses.name: Zakouma
horses.lead_up: Won Andrew Ramsden 2800m (May) to secure a start; 5th Herbert Power; last in a 1600m fitness run.

horses.name: Shockletz
horses.lead_up: Won Archer Stakes 2500m (3 from 3 at 2500m); fast-finishing 2nd in Tesio Stakes. Minimum 51kg. Jockey injury watch.
